## Natural history notes

A large tiger moth characterized by bright white wings covered in bold black spots or rings, a fuzzy white body, and a metallic blue-black abdomen with orange markings that is usually hidden when the wings are closed. In Florida, the Giant Leopard Moth is found in gardens, fields, hammocks, forest edges, parks, yards, roadsides, and other open or semi-open habitats with low plants and shrubs. Adults are mostly nocturnal and may come to lights, while the woolly black caterpillars feed on a wide variety of herbaceous plants and shrubs and curl into a defensive ball when disturbed.
